cards.text: A famine is coming, so the disciples in Antioch send relief to the brothers living in Judea (Acts 11:27-30). About that time, King Herod reaches out to harm some who belong to the church. He has James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword, and friend, this one starts heavy.

cards.question: Herod sees that killing James pleased the Jews. So what does Herod do next?

answers.text: He sends the church a warning

cards.text: So Herod has Peter, one of Jesus' twelve apostles (Matthew 10:2), arrested during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
Peter goes into prison, guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Friend, that's SIXTEEN soldiers for ONE man, and NOBODY ever guarded my cookie jar like that.

cards.question: Herod intends to bring Peter out to the people after the ___.
True or false: While Peter is kept in prison, the church is fervently praying to God for him.

cards.text: It's the night before Herod is set to bring Peter to trial. Sentries are standing guard at the entrance to the prison.

cards.question: On the night before his trial, Peter is ___ between two soldiers.

cards.text: Two soldiers, two chains, a trial coming, and the man is SLEEPING. Friend, I can't fall asleep if I'm not sure I turned the oven off!
Suddenly an angel of the Lord appears, and a light shines in the cell. He taps Peter on the side and wakes him up.

cards.question: The angel tells Peter, “Get up quickly.” True or false: Peter's chains fall off his wrists.

cards.text: Then the angel tells Peter to get dressed, put on his sandals, wrap his cloak around him and follow. Even in a prison break, friend, you put your shoes on first.

cards.question: Peter follows the angel out of the cell. What does Peter think is going on?

answers.text: The guards are setting a trap
Herod has decided to free him

cards.question: Peter and the angel pass the first and second guards and reach the iron gate leading to the city. What happens at the gate?

answers.text: It opens for them by itself
The angel breaks the lock off
A guard unlocks it for them

cards.question: True or false: Once they're out in the city, the angel walks Peter all the way to a friend's house.
Standing alone in the street, Peter comes to himself. What does Peter now know for sure?

answers.text: The Lord sent His angel to rescue him
The guards let him go on purpose
Herod changed his mind about him

cards.text: Once it sinks in, Peter goes to the house of Mary, the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people have gathered and are praying. He knocks at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda comes to answer it.

cards.question: Rhoda recognizes Peter's voice at the gate, and she's overjoyed. What does she do?

answers.text: Runs inside and leaves the gate shut
Throws the gate wide open for him
Faints right there at the gate

cards.text: She runs inside and announces, “Peter is standing at the gate!” Friend, that's like yelling that the cookies are done and leaving them IN THE OVEN.

cards.question: True or false: The people praying at Mary's house believe Rhoda right away.

cards.text: “You are out of your mind,” they tell her, and when she keeps insisting, they say, “It must be his angel.” Friend, Peter gets OUT of a guarded prison, and he still can't get INTO this house!

cards.question: Peter keeps on knocking. When they finally open the door and see him, they are ___.

cards.text: Peter motions with his hand for silence and describes how the Lord brought him out of the prison.
Then he tells them, “Send word to James and to the brothers.” That's not John's brother, friend. Herod already put that James to death (Acts 12:2).

cards.question: Once Peter gives his message about James and the brothers, what does Peter do?

answers.text: He stays the night at Mary's
He goes back to face Herod

cards.text: At daybreak there's no small commotion among the soldiers about what became of Peter. Sixteen soldiers, one empty cell, and I bet NOT ONE of them wants to be the guy who tells Herod.

cards.question: Herod searches for Peter and can't find him. After he examines the guards, what does Herod order?

answers.text: That the guards be locked up
That the guards be sent home

cards.text: Then Herod goes down from Judea to Caesarea and spends some time there.
Now Herod is in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They win the support of Blastus, the king's chamberlain, and ask for peace.

cards.question: Tyre and Sidon ask for peace because their region depends on the king's country for ___.
On the appointed day, Herod puts on his royal robes, sits on his throne and speaks to the people. What do they shout his voice is?

answers.text: The voice of a true king

cards.question: Immediately, an angel of the Lord strikes Herod down, because he did not give ___ to God.

cards.text: Herod is eaten by worms and dies. Herod is gone, but the word of God keeps spreading and multiplying.

cards.question: Barnabas and Saul, two teachers from the church in Antioch (Acts 11:26), finish their mission to Jerusalem and head back. Who do they bring with them?

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 8 quotes "Send word to James and to the brothers.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: The question uses “they” without identifying the people at Mary's house. That antecedent appears only on earlier cards, so the question does not fully supply its own context.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

findings.problem: The James in Acts 12:17 is a different person from John's brother, but the card only says who he is not. It never simply identifies this newly appearing James, leaving the baker to wonder which James Peter means.

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."
